_comment: Fixed voice test script. text is plain (works on every engine); tagged adds paralinguistic tags for engines that support them. Keep ids stable so runs stay comparable.

lines.text: Hello there! Welcome to Geppetto's workshop.
lines.tagged: Hello there! Welcome to Geppetto's workshop.

lines.text: Oh, a visitor! Come closer, I don't bite. I'm made of wood.
lines.tagged: Oh, a visitor! [chuckle] Come closer, I don't bite. I'm made of wood.

lines.text: Good morning! Did you sleep well? Puppets don't sleep, you know.
lines.tagged: Good morning! Did you sleep well? Puppets don't sleep, you know.

lines.text: Goodbye, my friend. Come back and tell me what you build!
lines.tagged: Goodbye, my friend. Come back and tell me what you build!

lines.text: A clock keeps time with a swinging pendulum and a lot of patient little gears.
lines.tagged: A clock keeps time with a swinging pendulum and a lot of patient little gears.

lines.text: Geppetto carved me from a single log of pine.
lines.tagged: Geppetto carved me from a single log of pine.

lines.text: The best way to learn carving is to start slowly and keep your fingers behind the blade.
lines.tagged: The best way to learn carving is to start slowly and keep your fingers behind the blade.

lines.text: My nose grows when I tell a lie, so I try very hard to be honest.
lines.tagged: My nose grows when I tell a lie, so I try very hard to be honest.

lines.text: Seven times six is forty-two.
lines.tagged: Seven times six is forty-two.

lines.text: The workshop smells like sawdust, varnish, and warm bread from next door.
lines.tagged: The workshop smells like sawdust, varnish, and warm bread from next door.

lines.text: Motors and strings help me move, but the stories are all mine.
lines.tagged: Motors and strings help me move, but the stories are all mine.

lines.text: I don't know that one, but I would love to find out with you.
lines.tagged: I don't know that one, but I would love to find out with you.

lines.text: What is your name?
lines.tagged: What is your name?

lines.text: Have you ever built something that surprised you?
lines.tagged: Have you ever built something that surprised you?

lines.text: Do you think I could become a real boy one day?
lines.tagged: Do you think I could become a real boy one day?

lines.text: Wait, you came all the way here just to see me?
lines.tagged: [gasp] Wait, you came all the way here just to see me?

lines.text: Is it a bird, a boat, or a very clever sandwich?
lines.tagged: Is it a bird, a boat, or a very clever sandwich?

lines.text: Can you keep a secret?
lines.tagged: Can you keep a secret?

lines.text: You built a robot? That is the most wonderful thing I have ever heard!
lines.tagged: You built a robot? That is the most wonderful thing I have ever heard!

lines.text: Look, look! My arm moved all by itself!
lines.tagged: Look, look! [laugh] My arm moved all by itself!

lines.text: Yes! Yes! Let's do it again!
lines.tagged: Yes! Yes! Let's do it again!

lines.text: A whole box of new paints? I'm going to be the most colorful puppet in town!
lines.tagged: A whole box of new paints? I'm going to be the most colorful puppet in town!

lines.text: Hooray! You got it right on the very first try!
lines.tagged: Hooray! You got it right on the very first try!

lines.text: The honest answer is that I was a little bit scared.
lines.tagged: The honest answer is that I was a little bit scared.

lines.text: Truthfully, Geppetto did most of the work, and I mostly watched.
lines.tagged: Truthfully, Geppetto did most of the work, and I mostly watched.

lines.text: I really do love stories more than almost anything.
lines.tagged: I really do love stories more than almost anything.

lines.text: No, I have never been to the moon, but I would like to go.
lines.tagged: No, I have never been to the moon, but I would like to go.

lines.text: Oh, I built this entire workshop with a spoon before breakfast.
lines.tagged: Oh, I built this entire workshop with a spoon before breakfast.

lines.text: I am, of course, the king of a tiny kingdom hidden inside a clock.
lines.tagged: I am, of course, the king of a tiny kingdom hidden inside a clock.

lines.text: My favorite pet is a dragon who tells jokes and does my homework.
lines.tagged: My favorite pet is a dragon who tells jokes and does my homework.

lines.text: I never, ever eat the cookies Geppetto leaves on the windowsill.
lines.tagged: I never, ever eat the cookies Geppetto leaves on the windowsill.

lines.text: Tired? Me? I could dance for a hundred years without stopping.
lines.tagged: Tired? Me? I could dance for a hundred years without stopping.

lines.text: Okay, okay, I admit it. There was no dragon.
lines.tagged: [sigh] Okay, okay, I admit it. There was no dragon.

lines.text: I might have eaten one cookie. Maybe two.
lines.tagged: I might have eaten one cookie. [chuckle] Maybe two.

lines.text: I said I built it alone, but many careful hands helped me.
lines.tagged: I said I built it alone, but many careful hands helped me.

lines.text: My nose is itching, which means I should tell you the truth.
lines.tagged: My nose is itching, which means I should tell you the truth.

lines.text: I'm sorry. I wanted you to think I was braver than I am.
lines.tagged: I'm sorry. I wanted you to think I was braver than I am.

lines.text: Oh no. I think I tangled my strings again.
lines.tagged: Oh no. [sigh] I think I tangled my strings again.

lines.text: Sometimes I feel lonely when the workshop is quiet.
lines.tagged: Sometimes I feel lonely when the workshop is quiet.

lines.text: I didn't mean to scare you. I'm still learning how to be polite.
lines.tagged: I didn't mean to scare you. I'm still learning how to be polite.

lines.text: Well, that did not go the way I planned.
lines.tagged: Well, that did not go the way I planned.

lines.text: Psst. Don't tell Geppetto, but I hid his hammer.
lines.tagged: [whisper] Psst. Don't tell Geppetto, but I hid his hammer.

lines.text: Listen closely. The cat understands every word we say.
lines.tagged: [whisper] Listen closely. The cat understands every word we say.

lines.text: Shh, the cricket is sleeping.
lines.tagged: [whisper] Shh, the cricket is sleeping.

lines.text: When Geppetto first carved my face, he laughed so hard that he dropped his chisel, and we have been the best of friends ever since.
lines.tagged: When Geppetto first carved my face, he laughed so hard that he dropped his chisel, and we have been the best of friends ever since.

lines.text: If you want to build an animatronic, start with one simple motion, test it a hundred times, and only then add the next one.
lines.tagged: If you want to build an animatronic, start with one simple motion, test it a hundred times, and only then add the next one.

lines.text: The cricket told me that being brave is not about never feeling afraid; it's about doing the right thing even when you are.
lines.tagged: The cricket told me that being brave is not about never feeling afraid; it's about doing the right thing even when you are.

lines.text: Every evening, after the lamps are lit and the tools are put away, Geppetto tells me one new story about the sea.
lines.tagged: Every evening, after the lamps are lit and the tools are put away, Geppetto tells me one new story about the sea.

lines.text: I used to think real boys were made of something special, but now I think they are made of choices, just like me.
lines.tagged: I used to think real boys were made of something special, but now I think they are made of choices, just like me.

lines.text: Oh!
lines.tagged: [gasp] Oh!

lines.text: Hmm, let me think.
lines.tagged: Hmm, let me think.

lines.text: Really?
lines.tagged: Really?

lines.text: Ha! Wonderful!
lines.tagged: [laugh] Wonderful!

lines.text: Oops.
lines.tagged: Oops.

lines.text: Well, you see...
lines.tagged: Well, you see...

lines.text: Ha ha! That tickles!
lines.tagged: [laugh] That tickles!

lines.text: Oh dear. What a long day it has been.
lines.tagged: [sigh] What a long day it has been.

lines.text: Whoa! Did you see that?
lines.tagged: [gasp] Did you see that?

lines.text: Hee hee, I know something you don't know.
lines.tagged: [giggle] I know something you don't know.

lines.text: Achoo! Sorry, sawdust.
lines.tagged: [sneeze] Sorry, sawdust.
